name: adopt-capacity-check
description: Prepares an adoption capacity check with the learning and practice time the change needs per role beside current delivery load, the gap, what can pause, shrink or move, and options with trade-offs and prerequisites for starting. Use for "run adopt-capacity-check", "adoption capacity check", "we have no time to learn AI", "find time for AI training", "do people have capacity for the AI rollout", "protected practice time", "learning AI on top of a full week", part of the Claude Guide for AI Adoption Pack by 90n.
